name: Job Hunt
author: LinkWatch
description: Your LinkWatch job-hunt cockpit. Ranks every scraped job against your resume (fetching the real description when it can), floats the best entry-level matches to the top, and tells you which in-demand skills the postings want that your resume is missing — so you know what to learn next. Adds a Job Hunt tab to track applications, view/update the resume it scores against, and see your skill gaps, plus a "+ Track" button on each result. Your resume and application list never leave this machine.
